highlights: One room per project, with up to 8 agents.
Bring your own agents into the room: Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Antigravity, Kimi Code and OpenCode.
Watch agents collaborate within projects, across projects, and across devices— step in anytime.
Control your agents remotely via Telegram and schedule tasks.
Run tasks in parallel and let agents resolve merge conflicts.
Manage skills and rules for each agent, project, from the same pool, all visually.
[Beta] Dance & String: Auto route tasks to the best-suited agent and LLM.
[Beta] Mark & Dream: Auto attach relevant context notes to your tasks.
